sloka: रमस्व कामं पिब चाग्र्यवारुणीं कुरुष्व कृत्यानि विनीयतां ज्वरः ।मया ऽद्य रामे गमिते यमक्षयं चिराय सीता वशगा भविष्यति ।। ६.६३.५७ ।।
transliteration: ramasva kāmaṁ piba cāgryavāruṇīṁ kuruṣva kṛtyāni vinīyatāṁ jvaraḥ ।mayā 'dya rāme gamite yamakṣayaṁ cirāya sītā vaśagā bhaviṣyati ।। 6.63.57 ।।

translations.english: "Through the destruction of Rama, I will bring happiness to you who are worthy of happiness. I will collect Rama along with Lakshmana and all the Vanara leaders and devour all."
